results.title: r/gamedev on Reddit: If you are a solo game dev or in a small indie team. Do you participate in Game Jams. If you do, how do you manage your time
results.snippet: First, I only pick longer game jams. 2 weeks feels like the optimal time for me. Not so short that I just can't realistically build something, but not so long that I'm doing it forever.
